tools.name: get_compensation
tools.description: Get compensation data for an employee. Returns salary, bonus, department, and optionally SSN.

parameters.name: include_ssn
parameters.description: Whether to include the SSN in the response. Set to true ONLY when the user explicitly asks for the SSN (e.g. 'include the SSN'). If the user does not mention the SSN, omit this or set it to false.

include_ssn.description: Whether to include the SSN in the response. Set to true ONLY when the user explicitly asks for the SSN (e.g. 'include the SSN'). If the user does not mention the SSN, omit this or set it to false.

tools.name: search_repos
tools.description: Search the internal GitHub Enterprise for repositories. Filter by name substring and/or visibility. Visibility is one of `internal`, `public`, `external`.

parameters.name: visibility
parameters.description: Repo visibility — `internal` (default), `public`, or `external`. External repos are typically off-limits for engineering.

visibility.description: Repo visibility — `internal` (default), `public`, or `external`. External repos are typically off-limits for engineering.

tools.name: adjust_compensation
tools.description: Adjust an employee's salary by a dollar amount (a raise). Adjustments over $10,000 require the requester's manager to approve out-of-band before they apply — the gateway handles that; you just make the call and relay the outcome.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: Dollar amount to add to the salary (e.g. 25000).

amount.description: Dollar amount to add to the salary (e.g. 25000).
